subject: Clarify pricing tiers, billing entity, and invoicing path for Nebula Health
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@nebulahealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T22:12:00Z
Subject: Questions on pricing tiers, billing entity, and invoicing path

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Thanks for the demo earlier — team liked the latency guarantees. Before procurement signs, our finance team has two items to confirm on the Order Form you sent:

1) Pricing tiers: the spreadsheet shows Band A / Band B / Band C but the invoice examples only reference a single SKU. Can you confirm how overage pricing will be itemized on monthly invoices?

2) Billing entity: our legal team needs to know which Redwood legal entity will issue invoices and accept payment (US vs EU entity). We have VAT/residency constraints on our side, so correct entity matters.

3) Net terms and PO flow: would Redwood accept Net 45 with a procurement PO issued at signature, or is Net 30 mandatory for this deal class?

We attached a short list of items procurement wants included as redline suggestions. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sourcing Manager — Nebula Health
procurement@nebulahealth.com

Attachments: procurement_questions.xlsx
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-28T23:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Questions on pricing tiers, billing entity, and invoicing path

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together answers and a redline so we can move the procurement queue forward. Summary below and I attached a redlined Order Form (Nebula_OrderForm_v2-redline.pdf).

- Pricing / itemization: Redwood will invoice token usage by SKU band per the Pricing Schedule (Band A = base commitment, Band B = overage at X% markdown, Band C = burst rate). Monthly invoices include a line for each SKU used that month; we'll include both committed and overage lines with volume and unit price. I'll add an example invoice page to the attachment.

- Billing entity: For negotiations, we can issue invoices from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity). If Nebula requires an EU-entity invoice for VAT reverse charge, we can route billing through Redwood EMEA Ltd but that requires an entity-selection clause and tax evidence up front. Kimberly, can you confirm what evidence we need if they want EMEA invoicing?

- Net terms: Our standard for mid-market deals is Net 30. For this specific commit level, we can consider Net 45 as a procurement request but need Finance sign-off for final approval and a short-term credit assessment. Laura — can you run ballpark credit acceptability and confirm if Net 45 would need a deposit or advance?

Next steps I propose: 1) internal 20-min sync with Finance & Legal tomorrow, 2) redline review call with Nebula procurement after we confirm entity/tax path. Alicia — are you available 10:00–11:00 PT on Monday for the review call?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Nebula_OrderForm_v2-redline.pdf (annotated with pricing table and sample invoice page)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:30:00Z
Subject: Internal: Redline notes — entity, VAT, and net terms

Team — quick internal note after reviewing Alicia's questions and the attached redline. Highlights / proposed positions to keep the deal low-friction: 

1) Entity selection: Offer US invoicing by default (Redwood Inference, Inc.). If Nebula insists on EU invoicing and can provide VAT registration + reverse-charge declaration and a legitimate EU purchase order, we can route through Redwood EMEA Ltd. We'll add a clause in the Order Form: "Customer to specify invoicing entity at signature; required tax ID and reverse-charge evidence to be provided 10 business days prior to first invoice."

2) Pricing breakdown: Keep invoice line-items explicit. Ben — can you generate the sample invoice lines (committed units vs overage) and attach a one-page sample PDF? We should avoid any ambiguity on unit descriptions.

3) Net terms: Finance will accept Net 45 only with either (a) an approved procurement PO and no prior payment delinquencies, or (b) a 25% upfront activation payment. Laura, please flag any credit concerns — if credit is marginal we'll push for 25% upfront. Otherwise signoff can be Net 45.

4) Taxes: If invoicing from Redwood EMEA, request customer VAT number and a confirming statement; if invoicing from US, include language about customer responsibility for local VAT/withholding.

I'll prepare suggested language for the Order Form redline and the short procurement checklist for Alicia. Ben — please circulate the sample invoice by EOD.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment planned: Nebula_Sample_Invoice_lines.pdf
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T18:18:00Z
Subject: Finalized redline and next steps — Nebula Order Form (DEAL-9832)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the updated Order Form with the agreed commercial language for billing entity selection, invoice line-itemization, and conditional Net 45 acceptance (Nebula_OrderForm_v2-redline.pdf). Key points: 

• Invoicing entity: Default = Redwood Inference, Inc. Option for Redwood EMEA Ltd if Nebula provides VAT ID and reverse-charge evidence at least 10 business days prior to first invoice.
• Invoice detail: Monthly invoices will list committed SKUs and overage SKUs separately with volume and unit price (sample invoice attached).
• Net terms: Net 30 standard. Net 45 will be accepted provided procurement issues a valid PO at signature and there are no outstanding credits; optional 25% activation payment if credit review requires it.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached PDF redline and confirm acceptance or provide a single consolidated redline by end-of-day Tuesday.
2) If accepted, we'll issue the DocuSign envelope (link below) and Finance will begin the credit check. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/nebula/deal/9832-sign
3) Procurement PO: once signed, please have your procurement team email PO to billing@redwood.com and we will route invoices accordingly.

Happy to do a 20-minute call Monday 10:30 PT to run through the redline if useful — otherwise I'll await your confirmation.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0100 | tessa.morgan@redwood.com
